posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha teaser dropped Jun 10 — Alia's fierce spy avatar in YRF's Spy Universe is breaking the internet. Film releases Jul 3 with SRK's special shoutout.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Main Vaapas Aaunga released Jun 12 with Sharvari and Naseeruddin Shah (directed by Imtiaz Ali, music by AR Rahman). Also gearing up for Sardaar Ji 3 on Jun 27.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King filming in Cape Town with Deepika Padukone — leaked set photos went viral. The action-thriller is locked for a blockbuster Dec 24 release.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Announced second pregnancy while juggling two massive films — King with SRK and Raaka with Allu Arjun, using a body double for action sequences.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Don 3 exit controversy and FWICE ban (now lifted) dominated headlines. Dhurandhar franchise crossed ₹3,100 cr combined. Expecting second child with Deepika.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: In Mumbai for brother Siddharth's pre-wedding celebrations. Continuing work on SS Rajamouli's Varanasi and honored at the Gold Gala 2026.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Signed with Hollywood powerhouse Anonymous Content. Directing Krrish 4 (his directorial debut) set for 2027 release, while producing web series Storm for Prime Video.

posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Team dismissed comeback rumors as 'speculation and misinformation' (Jun 10). Shared adorable photo dump with baby Vihaan and Vicky Kaushal.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Daayra (with Meghna Gulzar) has wrapped shooting. Spotted at Aamir Khan's gathering and reportedly in talks for Raj-DK's next film with Salman Khan.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Raaka first look revealed — teaming with Atlee and Deepika Padukone for a pan-India blockbuster. Also announced AA23 with Lokesh Kanagaraj.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Eetha locks Aug 28 release date. Cleared in the 2022 drugs case — officially free of all charges after a long legal battle.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Stunned at Cannes 2026 with daughter Aaradhya — wore a breathtaking blush pink Sophie Couture gown at the L'Oréal gala.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Jana Nayagan (his final film before politics) continues to face censor delays. Mersal set to re-release across 100 screens for his 52nd birthday on Jun 22.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai released Jun 5 — the David Dhawan reunion rom-com with Pooja Hegde and Mrunal Thakur is generating strong box office buzz.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi crossed ₹213 cr India gross since Jun 4 release. Director removed contentious Janhvi Kapoor scenes after objectification backlash.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Dragon glimpse unveiled from Prashanth Neel's next blockbuster. Also reuniting with Trivikram and teaming up with Nelson Dilipkumar for the first time.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Married Vijay Deverakonda in Feb 2026! Now promoting Cocktail 2 and filming intense action role in Mysaa. Threatened legal action over leaked audio.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Candid about her postpartum journey with daughter Saraayah, winning hearts for keeping it real. Set to play Madhubala in Bhansali's biopic and star in Toxic with Yash.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Maa Inti Bangaaram trailer dropped to massive buzz. Married filmmaker Raj Nidimoru in Dec 2025 and delivered a powerful keynote at Women in Entertainment 2026.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Peddi objectification controversy made headlines, but Homebound premiered at Cannes Un Certain Regard to critical acclaim. Lag Ja Gale announced next.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: 'The Unstoppable' world tour spanning 21 concerts across 6 countries is underway. Won Best Playback Singer for Saiyaara and purchased a ₹29.7 cr Worli home.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Composed music for Main Vaapas Aaunga (released Jun 12). World premiered Rangreza at Royal Albert Hall with the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra. Also composing Ramayana with Hans Zimmer.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Celebrating her early birthday while filming her next project. Spotted at beauty events with besties Janhvi Kapoor and Shanaya Kapoor.
